intro: Money course for Latino entrepreneurs and self-employed people in the United States: 9 modules, 43 lessons, with federal rules and California examples.

modulos.M1: Module 1. Your business and your home: separate money
modulos.M4: Module 4. Get paid and sell without losing
modulos.M5: Module 5. Formalize and handle taxes without fear

resultados.M1: Your business money separate from your home, a tax account, a fixed salary and up-to-date records.
resultados.M2: Your costs calculated, your price with margin and your break-even point.
resultados.M3: Your cash-flow calendar, your customer credit rules and your reserve for slow seasons.
resultados.M4: Your payment methods compared and your plan against scams when you sell.
resultados.M5: Your structure, tax numbers, permits, estimated payments and sales tax in order.
resultados.M6: Knowing whether you need credit, what it really costs and how not to mix it with personal debt.
resultados.M7: Your health insurance, business insurance, trademark and protection against scams.
resultados.M8: Your rules for hiring, selling online and measuring how your business is doing.
resultados.M9: Your Social Security checked, your retirement account, your plan if the business changes and your one-page plan.

instalacion.aviso_foro: Do not share your SSN, ITIN, EIN, passwords, account numbers, your business's real amounts or your immigration status.

## 9. Community (optional, ask first)

Ask the person whether they want you to create the course **Your Business Community · U.S.** (`YBMF-US-EN-COM`, hidden). It has its own folder and instructions: `README_CREATE_COMMUNITY_FOR_CLAUDE.md`.

notas: Lessons do not recommend specific banks, processors, platforms or loans; they teach how to compare.
Federal rules with California examples; in other states, local rules are checked.
The course gives tax orientation, but each case is reviewed with a tax preparer or CPA. It does not give immigration advice.

descripcion: Separate your business money, price for profit, handle your taxes and protect your business.
Practical microlessons with cases from food, trades and online sales in the United States.
catalogo.para_quien: People who run their own small business in the United States (federal and California).

bienvenida.conecta: Starting a business in a new country takes double the effort: new rules, taxes in another language and customers who pay late. And still, here you are, moving your business forward. This program is so you truly profit, comply without fear and protect what you built, without asking for personal data or your immigration status.
bienvenida.despedida: Finishing this program is the result of your effort and persistence, on top of the daily work your business takes. Now you have prices with profit, your cash flow under control and your taxes in order.
